title: Read, park, build to the datum, write the figure

members.role: the first card pops at its reading box and is read while the sentence sets the number up
a second card takes the same place and parks, clearing the chart for what comes next
the line builds along the page to the datum the sentence has just named
the hand writes the figure at the datum the line arrived on

does: The cards are read and parked, then the line runs out to the number the sentence just said and the hand writes that number at the spot it landed on.
